SELECT
    kategorie                                                  AS "Kategorie",
    farbe                                                      AS "Farbe",
    betrag::float8                                             AS "Betrag",
    round(100.0 * betrag / nullif(monat_gesamt, 0), 1)::float8 AS "Anteil",
    monat_gesamt::float8                                       AS "Gesamt"
FROM v_ausgaben_monat_kategorie
WHERE monat = date_trunc('month', {{ (DatePicker_month.selectedDate || new Date().toISOString()) }}::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date
  AND betrag > 0
ORDER BY betrag DESC;
